THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 02 OF 1980

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of1980, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Repubic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendation ofthe Minister-in-Charge of the subject of Urban Development being of the opinion that the land specified in the Schedulebelow is urgently required for the restoration of the Bus Stand under the Town Development Project of Eheliyagoda, doby this order, declare that the said land is required for such purpose.

All allotments of land depicted as Lot A of Advanced Tracing No. R/EHL/2015/994 made by Superintendent ofSurvey on 17.06.2016, in respect of land situated in Kandegamuwa Village in Pallepattuwa Minor Division within the areaof authority of the Divisional Secretary’s Division, Eheliyagoda in the District of Ratnapura in Sabaragamuwa Provincecontaining in extent of about 01 acre, 00 roods and 12.01 perches of which boundaries are as follows :-

North:Eheliyagoda Pradheshiya Sabha premises and Pussellagehenewatta land where R/EheliyagodaCentral College is located.East:Pussellagehenewatta land where R/Eheliyagoda Central College is located and Lot No. BSouth:Lot No. B, Pussellagehene deniya claimed by L. R. Dharmasiri and others, and roads (RDA) ;West:Pussellagehene deniya claimed by L. R. Dharmasiri and others, Roads (RDA) andPussellagehenewatta land where Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha premises is located.
